title: Meeting script
subtitle: Shift-start meeting, every day at 7:00, 17:00 and 23:00 (3–5 min)
leaderBy: Leader: one person of the shift (taking turns)
point: Loud voice, big smile. At 17:00 and 23:00 we also say "Ohayō gozaimasu".

before.title: Before the meeting (5 min before)
before.stock: ① Stock: ask the previous shift
before.target: ② Target: check "Target bowls" in the app
before.caution: ③ Point to be careful about: choose one (you can use an example below)

notes.greeting: Stop working and look at the leader.
notes.philosophy: Say it together, in one voice.
notes.phrases: After the leader, say each phrase twice with a smile.
notes.handover: Listen carefully. If something is unclear, ask right away. If there are no questions:
notes.grooming: Check each other. Fix problems right away. If everything is OK:

cautionTitle: Examples of points to be careful about (choose one)

situations.title: In these cases
situations.customer: A customer comes in during the meeting → stop, everyone says "Irasshai!". Continue after serving.
situations.busy: Too many customers → customers first. When it is quiet, do only "3. Service phrases" and "4. Handover".
situations.few: Only 1–2 people → always do it, even with few people.

after.title: When finished
after.record: The leader sends the meeting record in the app.

lines.prepQuestion: Is there anything we need to order?
lines.start: We will start the meeting now. Good morning!
lines.philosophy3: ③ Give customers the best memories!
lines.phrasesStart: Let's practise the service phrases. With a smile, please.
lines.handoverTarget: Target: this shift's target is ○○ bowls.
lines.groomingStart: Grooming check: uniform, head towel, hair, nails, accessories.
lines.maido: Thank you! (when taking the meal ticket)
